editor.gegenstand.abhaengig.mit_entferne: Remove together with the dependent items
editor.gegenstand.abhaengig.satz_eins: “{name}” is an ingredient in the recipe of {anzahl} other item (below). Without it that recipe would be invalid and the file would be refused. If you go on, that item is removed with it; if you do not want that, cancel and take the ingredient out of the recipe first.
editor.gegenstand.abhaengig.satz_mehrere: “{name}” is an ingredient in the recipes of {anzahl} other items (below, also through intermediate products). Without it those recipes would be invalid and the file would be refused. If you go on, all of these items are removed with it; if you do not want that, cancel and take the ingredient out of the recipes first.
editor.gegenstand.abhaengig.titel: Item is needed as an ingredient
editor.gegenstand.bestaetigung.ohne_id: An entry without a readable identifier ({position})
editor.gegenstand.bestaetigung.satz_eins: {anzahl} item will be permanently deleted (see below). All copies in inventories and chests disappear permanently as well. This cannot be undone.
editor.gegenstand.bestaetigung.satz_erse: The current working file is unusable ({grund}). Saving replaces it with your state; a backup of the old file stays.
editor.gegenstand.bestaetigung.satz_mehr: {anzahl} items will be permanently deleted (see below). All copies in inventories and chests disappear permanently as well. This cannot be undone.
editor.gegenstand.feld.hat_rezept: The item has a recipe (no workbench needed)
editor.gegenstand.feld.id_hinweis_fest: Saved and fixed. A different name only changes the texts; a new identifier only comes from “Copy”.
editor.gegenstand.feld.id_hinweis_neu: Starts with a capital letter, letters and digits only, up to 32 characters. Fixed after the first save.
editor.gegenstand.feld.text_hinweis: One line, no control characters, at most {max} characters.
editor.gegenstand.grund.eintrag_kein_obj: The entry is not a valid object.
editor.gegenstand.grund.feld_ungueltig: A field is invalid (harvest, durability or rarity).
editor.gegenstand.grund.id_code_kollisio: This identifier already belongs to a built-in item.
editor.gegenstand.grund.id_schreibung_co: This identifier differs from a built-in item only in letter case.
editor.gegenstand.grund.id_schreibung_do: This identifier differs from another one only in letter case.
editor.gegenstand.grund.id_ungueltig: The identifier is invalid: a capital letter first, letters and digits only, 2 to 32 characters.
editor.gegenstand.grund.modell_ungueltig: The model settings are invalid (model, position, rotation or animation set).
editor.gegenstand.grund.rezept_selbstbez: An item cannot be its own ingredient.
editor.gegenstand.grund.rezept_ungueltig: The recipe is invalid: 1 to 20 different ingredients with an amount of 1 to 999.
editor.gegenstand.grund.rezept_zutat_unb: An ingredient does not exist (neither built in nor in this file).
editor.gegenstand.grund.rezept_zyklus: The recipe goes in a circle: an ingredient ends up needing this item.
editor.gegenstand.grund.schluessel_ungue: The text key does not match the identifier.
editor.gegenstand.grund.symbol_ungueltig: The icon name is invalid: letters, digits, underscore and hyphen only.
editor.gegenstand.grund.texte_name_fehlt: The name is missing in German or English. Both are required.
editor.gegenstand.grund.texte_schluessel: The texts do not belong to this item.
editor.gegenstand.grund.texte_ungueltig: A text is invalid: too long (more than 200 characters), invisible characters, or no letters or digits at all.
editor.gegenstand.grund.unbekannt: The server reports the reason “{code}”, which the mask does not know yet.
editor.gegenstand.grund.zu_viele_eintrae: The file already holds the maximum number of items (500).
editor.gegenstand.http.401: Access refused: the token is missing or wrong. Is the proxy in front running?
editor.gegenstand.http.403: Access refused: the operations service only answers the local network and its own page.
editor.gegenstand.http.andere: Unexpected answer of the operations service (status {status}).
editor.gegenstand.http.netz: The operations service can not be reached.
editor.gegenstand.http.zeit: The operations service did not answer in time (timeout). Nothing was confirmed; please reload and try again.
editor.gegenstand.knopf.hinweis: Opens the item mask: turn an uploaded model into a playable item.
editor.gegenstand.konflikt.eigene_behalt: Keep my version (when saving, overwrites the server version of the fields listed above; other server changes stay)
editor.gegenstand.konflikt.server_uebern: Take the server version (my draft is lost)
editor.gegenstand.konflikt.titel: This item has been changed on the server in the meantime. Nothing was saved. Choose which version counts:
editor.gegenstand.konflikt.titel_entfern: This item has been removed on the server in the meantime. Nothing was saved. Choose whether your draft stays as a new item or is dropped:
editor.gegenstand.konflikt.zusammengefue: The server has meanwhile also changed other fields of this item (fields: {felder}). Those changes are merged into your draft; your own changes are kept. Nothing saved yet.
editor.gegenstand.lokal.bereich: The value must be between {min} and {max}.
editor.gegenstand.lokal.ganzzahl: Only a whole number is allowed here.
editor.gegenstand.lokal.name_fehlt: The name is missing. It is required in German and English.
editor.gegenstand.lokal.text_ohne_zeiche: The name needs at least one letter or digit.
editor.gegenstand.lokal.text_steuerzeich: The text contains a character that is not allowed (control, invisible or direction-changing character).
editor.gegenstand.lokal.text_zeilenumbru: No line break allowed: the text must be on one line.
editor.gegenstand.lokal.text_zu_lang: The text is too long: at most {max} characters.
editor.gegenstand.lokal.vektor_unvollsta: Fill in all three values or leave all empty.
editor.gegenstand.lokal.zahl_ungueltig: This is not a valid number.
editor.gegenstand.lokal.zutaten_fehlen: A recipe needs at least one ingredient.
editor.gegenstand.route.alter_stand_kapu: The current working file is unusable. Nothing was saved.
editor.gegenstand.route.anfrage_zu_gross: The request is too large. Nothing was saved.
editor.gegenstand.route.basis_fehlt: The save lacked the state it builds on. Nothing was saved.
editor.gegenstand.route.basis_unbestimmt: The state the save builds on was unspecified. Nothing was saved.
editor.gegenstand.route.braucht_bestaeti: The save needs a confirmation. Nothing was saved.
editor.gegenstand.route.datei_kein_json: The file is not valid JSON.
editor.gegenstand.route.datei_kopf_falsc: The header of the file is wrong (version and list of items).
editor.gegenstand.route.datei_version_un: The version of the file is unknown.
editor.gegenstand.route.datei_zu_gross: The file is larger than 1 MB.
editor.gegenstand.route.datei_zu_viele_e: The file has more than 500 items.
editor.gegenstand.route.eintraege_verwor: The server refused entries as invalid. Nothing was saved.
editor.gegenstand.route.gesperrt: The item file is being written right now. Please try again shortly; nothing was saved.
editor.gegenstand.route.intern: Internal error in the operations service. Nothing was saved; details are in its log.
editor.gegenstand.route.methode: The operations service does not know this kind of request.
editor.gegenstand.route.repo_fehlt: The item file in the repo is missing; there is no state to edit yet.
editor.gegenstand.route.repo_kaputt: The item file in the repo is unusable; nothing was created.
editor.gegenstand.route.unbekannt: The operations service reports the error “{code}”, which the mask does not know yet.
editor.gegenstand.route.unbekannter_endp: The operations service does not know this address.
editor.gegenstand.route.veraltet: The file changed since it was loaded. Nothing was saved; please reload.
editor.gegenstand.seite.datei_kaputt: The working file is unusable ({grund}). Saving replaces it after a confirmation; a backup stays.
editor.gegenstand.seite.entfernt_woander: The open item was removed on the server; it has left the mask (you had not changed it).
editor.gegenstand.seite.gesperrt: The item file is being written right now. Please try again in about {sekunden} seconds; nothing was saved.
editor.gegenstand.seite.gesperrt_konflik: Decide the conflict above first; nothing was changed.
editor.gegenstand.seite.gesperrt_laedt: Loading right now; please wait. Nothing was changed.
editor.gegenstand.seite.gesperrt_speiche: Saving right now; please wait. Nothing was changed.
editor.gegenstand.seite.leer: No items yet. “New item” creates the first one.
editor.gegenstand.seite.unerwartet: Unexpected error; nothing was saved. Please reload and try again.
editor.gegenstand.seite.veraltet: The item file has been changed elsewhere in the meantime. Nothing was saved; the new state is loaded, your draft in the form is kept.
editor.gegenstand.seite.verwerfen_frage: Discard unsaved changes in the form?
editor.gegenstand.seite.verworfen_hinwei: {anzahl} entries of the working file are invalid and disappear with the next save: {liste}
editor.gegenstand.seite.verworfen_liste: The server refused {anzahl} entries; nothing was saved:
editor.gegenstand.seite.waehle: Pick an item on the left or create a new one.
editor.server.busy: A server action is already running — please wait.
editor.server.button.restart_hint: Restarts the game server — independent of test-world state, always available.
editor.server.button.stop_hint: Stops the game server. Nobody can log in until you start it again.
editor.server.live_test.active_title: Test world is running — saves your draft and rebuilds the test world fresh (no switching again).
editor.server.live_test.inactive_title: Restarts the game server with the saved map state.
editor.server.live_test.refresh_body: The test world is already running. Your draft is saved (the same file the server rebuilds from). The game server stops briefly, the RUNNING test world is discarded (it stays around as testwelt.db.zst) and rebuilt completely fresh from the layout. All players are disconnected.
editor.server.live_test.refresh_title: Test the map live — rebuild the test world?
editor.server.live_test.save_failed: Layout was not saved — server was not restarted.
editor.server.restart.body: All players are disconnected and have to reconnect. The server then loads the last saved game state — that stays as it is. This will NOT apply map changes: use "Test map live" for that.
editor.server.restart.just_restart_hint: Unsaved changes in the editor do NOT go to the server with this.
editor.server.restart.title: Restart the server now?
editor.server.stop.body: All players are disconnected. The server stays stopped until you start it again here.
editor.server.stop.confirm_hint: Nobody can log in until you start it again.
editor.server.stop.title: Stop the server now?
editor.server.wait.label: Service {zustand}
editor.server.wait.timeout: Timed out after 60s without a confirmed target state — please check the status above.
editor.upload.cm_titel: Raw size was likely exported in centimetres — divide the target value by 100.
editor.upload.dimension_titel: Which edge the target size sets — the other edge grows proportionally.
editor.upload.entfernen_bestaetigen: '{name}' is still placed {anzahl} times{orte}. Remove anyway? The placements stay, but show no model afterwards.
editor.upload.grundskala_aendern_titel: Change the base scale in the registry — affects every placement of this model.
editor.upload.grundskala_begrenzt: Base scale limited to {grenze} (target value would be ×{ziel}) — uploaded/previewed with {grenze}.
editor.upload.hinweis_neustart: Visible immediately in the catalogue and in the test flight. In the running game (game server process) only visible, with collision, after a restart of the game server.
editor.upload.kollision_titel: Collision: solid blocks players, passable is pure decoration. Default: solid.
editor.upload.name_titel: Display name — the server turns it into a valid, collision-free file name
editor.upload.uebernommen_hinweis: Applied — catalogue, newly opened and already open test flights immediately; game clients only after a reload, the collision on a running game server only after its restart (server control in the editor).
editor.upload.zielgroesse_kante_titel: Target size in metres for the chosen edge — computes the base scale from the raw registry size.
editor.upload.zielgroesse_titel: Target size in metres — empty means "as in the file" (base scale 1). The suggestion fills in after name and file.

testflug.aktionen.gesperrt: Release first — no turning or renaming while dragging
testflug.auswahl_verworfen: Selection discarded — pick a prefab in the list to start the preview again
testflug.baumodus_an: Build mode ON — WASD flies, Space rises, X/Ctrl sinks, wheel zooms far, V ends it
testflug.baumodus_aus: Build mode OFF — character falls to the ground
testflug.bewuchs.abweichung: Vegetation preview may differ from the game: {teile}
testflug.bewuchs.ohne_manifest_eintrag: Manifest has no entry for placed prefabs: {namen}
testflug.bewuchs_vorschau_hinweis: Vegetation preview: grows in around you (G rebuilds it)
testflug.doppelte_id_nicht_gegriffen: Duplicate id {id} in the draft — not grabbed
testflug.doppelte_ids: Duplicate ids in the draft ({ids}) — these entries cannot be grabbed, turned or deleted
testflug.gegriffen: {prefab} grabbed — dragging moves it, Del deletes
testflug.gelaende.entwurf_uebernommen: The draft was changed in another tab — the ground follows it ({n} points adjusted)
testflug.gelaende.entwurf_unbrauchbar: The terrain correction in the draft is unusable (errors or over the limits) — the brush stays locked
testflug.gelaende.grenze.punkte: Too many corrected points in the document (limit 100,000)
testflug.gelaende.grenze.wert: A point would exceed the limit of ±100 m correction
testflug.gelaende.hoehe.beschaedigt: Not saved, no restart: the terrain correction in the draft is damaged ({grund}). Nothing was sent.
testflug.gelaende.kein_entwurf: No draft — the terrain cannot be saved
testflug.gelaende.kein_geo: This ground takes no hand correction (not layout mode)
testflug.gelaende.konflikt: The draft changed under the stroke (another tab?)
testflug.gelaende.leere_route: Empty route not saved (no point yet).
testflug.gelaende.strich_gespeichert: Stroke saved in the draft ({n} points). “Save to world” writes it to the world file.
testflug.gelaende.tip: Dragging shapes the ground: raise, lower (Shift swaps raise/lower) or smooth. Plinths and buildings lock the brush (red circle). Alt+click grabs objects as usual. Esc or right click ends the tool; in the game the correction takes effect after saving and a server restart.
testflug.gelaende.tip3: Level pulls the ground to the target height: key H reads the height under the pointer (pipette), or press the "Pipette" button and click the ground, or type the number. Reset removes the hand correction under the brush. Ctrl+Z takes back the last stroke, Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z puts it in again; if a building or plinth now stands on the stroke this is refused, and then for the older strokes below it as well. Every object that has no plinth and is neither a building nor a building part moves with the ground (buildings and parts lock the brush).
testflug.gelaende.verlauf_gesperrt: {n} points of this step lie under a building or plinth — step not possible (remove the building or plinth first, or use "Reset")
testflug.gelaende.verworfen.beschaedigt: Not saved, no restart: the draft contains damaged parts that cleaning would drop ({liste}). Nothing was sent.
testflug.gelaende.ziel_fehlt: Choose a target height first: key H over the ground (pipette), the "Pipette" button or a number in the "Target height" field
testflug.gelaende.ziel_m: Target height (m) for levelling — key H = pipette
testflug.gespeichert_neustart_noetig: {message} — restart the server so the world loads it
testflug.inselwahl.ausserhalb_region: Spot ({x}, {z}) lies outside every region — open sea, there is nothing to enter there.
testflug.inselwahl.hinweis: Opens the test flight with the draft on the island centre. Or: point over the map, key T — then right at that spot.
testflug.inselwahl.im_wasser: Spot ({x}, {z}) in {region} lies in the water (terrain {gelaende} m, water line {wasserlinie} m).
testflug.inselwahl.kein_land: {id} has no land above the water line — there is nothing to enter there.
testflug.inselwahl.kein_land_punkt: {id} has no land above the water line.
testflug.inselwahl.keine_gueltige_stelle: No valid spot in the address.
testflug.inselwahl.keine_regionen: The draft has no regions — draw an island first.
testflug.inselwahl.suche_abgebrochen: Search aborted after {sekunden} s — no land found in {id} until then, it presumably has none.
testflug.inselwahl.suche_dabei_abgebroch: , the search was aborted after {sekunden} s
testflug.inselwahl.ziel_niedrig: {id}: the target lies low — only {hoehe} m above the water line
testflug.kein_prefab_aktiv: No prefab active — click one in the list (B) first
testflug.keine_id: This placement has no id — open and save it in the editor, that is where it gets one.
testflug.lage.rat: The character stands at the origin. Close the tab and pick a spot on land in the map.
testflug.loeschsperre: {count} deletion(s) held back and not carried out yet — confirm them in the map editor.
testflug.neustart.fehler.aktion_laeuft: Another server action is running right now (second tab?). Please wait a moment and try again.
testflug.neustart.fehler.entwurf_unlesba: The draft in the browser storage cannot be read ({fehler}). Nothing was sent.
testflug.neustart.fehler.gesperrt: While "Save & restart" is running, saving is locked.
testflug.neustart.fehler.netz: Connection to the operations service failed: {fehler}
testflug.neustart.fehler.speichert_noch: Saving is still going on. Please wait a moment and try again.
testflug.neustart.fehler.zeitlimit: The server is not back up after {sekunden} s. Please check in the map editor.
testflug.neustart.status.laeuft_unklar: The server is running (after {sekunden} s), but it is unclear whether the restart was carried out. The world is saved; the terrain change only applies after a confirmed restart.
testflug.neustart.status.laeuft_wieder: Server is running again (after {sekunden} s) — the terrain change is loaded.
testflug.neustart.status.loeschsperre: {count} object deletion(s) stay in place until confirmed in the map editor.
testflug.neustart.status.startet_neu_unk: No answer to the restart, checking the state … {sekunden} s
testflug.neustart.status.striche: Changes you made while the run went on are not on the server yet: please save again.
testflug.neustart.text: The world is saved and the game server restarts. All players are disconnected briefly and reconnect automatically. Terrain changes then apply to everyone.
testflug.neustart.titel: Save the world and restart the server?
testflug.persistenz.erst_absetzen_abgele: Release first — the drag was refused
testflug.persistenz.local.ohne_basis: Saving from the test flight needs an editor state – please reconcile the server state in the editor (click the "WELT" field top left; needed after a JSON import) and save there.
testflug.persistenz.local.unbestaetigt: The service did not confirm the save (no valid answer with a new state). The state is unclear, the base stays unchanged, no restart.
testflug.persistenz.local.veraltet: The world on the server has changed in the meantime and your draft does not rest on it – nothing was overwritten. Please reconcile in the editor (load the server state or "keep draft") and save there.
testflug.persistenz.local.verlangt: The operations service requires a base to save and wrote nothing – please reconcile the server state in the editor (click the "WELT" field top left) and save there.
testflug.persistenz.nicht_gesendet_stand: not sent, the state is unclear
testflug.persistenz.nicht_gesendet_unkla: not sent, because an earlier operation stayed unclear
testflug.persistenz.verworfen_frueher: Discarded because an earlier operation was refused
testflug.persistenz.zurueck.nicht: — draft NOT rolled back, please reload
testflug.routen_editor_offen: Route editor open — pick/create a route, ✎ arms placement, R closes
testflug.routen_zeichnen_aktiv: Route drawing active — end it with ✎ or Esc first
testflug.rueckweg_nicht_moeglich: Cannot go back — the browser has no channel to the editor
testflug.spawn.gesperrt_titel: {name} is not in EIGENE_MODELLE (shared/src/prefabs.ts) and, since Block A, no longer belongs in the world: the client has no model for it, and pruefeLayout rejects the placement when the server starts.
testflug.spawn.gesperrt_zeile: {gesperrt} of {gesamt} without an own model — grey, not placeable.
testflug.spawn.npc.name: Name
testflug.spawn.npc.tip: Fields left empty inherit the prefab default. To edit a different character: click it in the world.
testflug.spawn.serie: Series (place several in a row; Esc/right click ends it, Alt+click grabs)
testflug.spawn.tip: Click an entry to start placing it (ghost follows the mouse). Click/P places it once and ends it; click the entry again for another copy. Cancel: click again, Esc, or right click.
testflug.spawn.untergrund_einebnen: Level the ground (manual, for large buildings)
testflug.spawn.zaehler_vorauswahl: Preselected: {prefab} (click in the list activates it)
testflug.spawn_editor_offen: Spawn editor open — click a prefab to start placing, B closes
testflug.sprung_abgelehnt_bleibt: The jump was refused, there is no spot for the map — please close this tab yourself
testflug.stelle_geschickt: Spot sent to the editor — only an editor open in the same browser profile centres the map. Please close this tab yourself
testflug.wegpunkt_gegriffen: Waypoint {n} of {route} grabbed — dragging moves it
